businesses.business: property and casualty insurance and reinsurance

offering_description.value: W. R. Berkley underwrites specialty property and casualty insurance for businesses, public entities and affluent households. It also assumes risk from other insurers through reinsurance and administers claims for self-insured organizations. It operates through specialized underwriting units and reaches customers mainly through independent agents and brokers.

primary_products.value: commercial property and liability insurance; workers’ compensation insurance; excess liability insurance; high-value personal insurance; property and casualty reinsurance

primary_services.value: third-party claims administration for self-insured programs

customer_segment.value: B2B: Businesses, private institutions, self-insured employers and property and casualty insurers; B2C: Affluent households insuring homes, vehicles and valuables; B2G: Municipalities, school districts and other public entities

end_markets.value: construction; manufacturing; professional services; personal property and casualty insurance; insurance and reinsurance

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: Premiums for commercial and personal insurance policies and reinsurance contracts; service fees: Claims administration for self-insured programs

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Underwrites risks for businesses, public entities and households and assumes ceded risks from insurers; service provider: Handles claims on behalf of self-insured organizations

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Latin America, the United Kingdom, continental Europe, Asia and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: Specialty commercial insurance, high-value personal insurance, reinsurance and claims administration

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: Independent retail agents, wholesale insurance brokers and reinsurance brokers; direct sales: Direct underwriting relationships with insurers for some reinsurance business

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Insurance licensing, solvency and market conduct oversight by U.S. state insurance departments and foreign regulators
